items.title: A rail of windows
items.text: Collapsed in all-windows mode, the rail shows one tile per window, in the list's order, with no dividers. Click a tile to bring that window forward.

items.title: See which windows are busy
items.text: A folded window's row, and every window's rail tile, shimmers while any of its panes is busy.

items.title: Your window stands out
items.text: The window you're in is highlighted in the all-windows list whether it's folded or open, and on the rail.

items.title: Groups fold cleanly
items.text: Windows without a project: prefix list above every group, so folding a group hides all of it. Every tab in a tab group joins its group.

items.title: The right + on the rail
items.text: The collapsed rail's + adds a pane in Panes mode and opens a window in all-windows mode.

items.title: Snappier drags
items.text: Dragging a window or group starts without lag, nothing lights up under the pointer mid-drag, and the dragged item lifts on clear glass and glides from where you let it go.
